hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q 'src/Root.tsx' && npm run sync:viewer >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'viewer registry synced' || true

input=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE '^git commit|; *git commit|&& *git commit'; then npx tsc --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCKED: tsc --noEmit failing — fix type errors before committing' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
